cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(uwvm_dobot LANGUAGES C CXX)
# Source SDK opt-in only; adding this directory builds nothing by default.
option(UWVM_DOBOT_BUILD_CONTRACTS "Build authored complete-value contracts" OFF)
option(UWVM_DOBOT_BUILD_WASI_EXAMPLES "Build genuine controlled WASI entries" OFF)
set(UWVM_DOBOT_PROFILE "" CACHE STRING "Exact original driver domain")
set_property(CACHE UWVM_DOBOT_PROFILE PROPERTY STRINGS ros1_v3 ros1_v4 ros2_v4)
set(UWVM_DOBOT_SOURCE_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Absolute frozen repository source")
set(UWVM_DOBOT_GENERATED "" CACHE PATH "Absolute matching complete generated family")
if(NOT UWVM_DOBOT_BUILD_CONTRACTS AND NOT UWVM_DOBOT_BUILD_WASI_EXAMPLES)
  return()
endif()
set(profiles ros1_v3 ros1_v4 ros2_v4)
list(FIND profiles "${UWVM_DOBOT_PROFILE}" profile_index)
if(profile_index LESS 0)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "One exact original DOBOT ROS/protocol source domain required")
endif()
math(EXPR profile_number "${profile_index}+1")
foreach(path IN ITEMS "${UWVM_DOBOT_SOURCE_ROOT}" "${UWVM_DOBOT_GENERATED}")
  if(NOT IS_ABSOLUTE "${path}" OR NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${path}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Actual absolute source and generated directories required")
  endif()
endforeach()
set(original "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/catalogs/${UWVM_DOBOT_PROFILE}")
set(bundle "${UWVM_DOBOT_GENERATED}")
foreach(name IN ITEMS generation.vendor.json preparation.vendor.json profile-selection.json)
  if(IS_SYMLINK "${bundle}/${name}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Symlinked source bundle metadata refused")
  endif()
endforeach()
file(READ "${bundle}/generation.vendor.json" generation)
file(READ "${bundle}/preparation.vendor.json" preparation)
file(READ "${bundle}/profile-selection.json" selection)
file(READ "${original}/source-lock.json" lock)
file(SHA256 "${original}/source-lock.json" lock_sha)
string(JSON captured_lock GET "${selection}" source_lock_sha256)
string(JSON captured_profile GET "${selection}" profile)
if(NOT captured_lock STREQUAL lock_sha OR NOT captured_profile STREQUAL UWVM_DOBOT_PROFILE)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Exact original DOBOT source profile differs from bundle")
endif()
file(SHA256 "${original}/catalog.json" catalog_sha)
string(JSON prepared_catalog GET "${preparation}" original_catalog sha256)
if(NOT prepared_catalog STREQUAL catalog_sha)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Original full catalog differs from prepared bundle")
endif()
string(JSON count LENGTH "${lock}" definitions)
math(EXPR last "${count}-1")
foreach(index RANGE 0 ${last})
  string(JSON name GET "${lock}" definitions ${index} generation_file)
  string(JSON expected GET "${lock}" definitions ${index} sha256)
  string(JSON prepared GET "${preparation}" original_definitions "${name}" sha256)
  file(SHA256 "${original}/${name}" actual)
  if(NOT actual STREQUAL expected OR NOT actual STREQUAL prepared)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Complete original declaration differs: ${name}")
  endif()
endforeach()
string(JSON count LENGTH "${generation}" outputs)
string(JSON native GET "${generation}" native_registry_emitted)
string(JSON mode GET "${preparation}" mode)
if(native)
  if(NOT count EQUAL 16 OR NOT mode STREQUAL "bind")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Native products require independent complete binding")
  endif()
elseif(NOT count EQUAL 14 OR NOT mode STREQUAL "prepare")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "All six complete record and interface sources required")
endif()
math(EXPR last "${count}-1")
foreach(index RANGE 0 ${last})
  string(JSON name MEMBER "${generation}" outputs ${index})
  if(name MATCHES "(^/|(^|/)[.][.](/|$))" OR IS_SYMLINK "${bundle}/${name}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Generated source escaped selected family")
  endif()
  string(JSON expected GET "${generation}" outputs "${name}" sha256)
  string(JSON selected GET "${selection}" products "${name}" sha256)
  string(JSON expected_bytes GET "${generation}" outputs "${name}" bytes)
  file(SHA256 "${bundle}/${name}" actual)
  file(SIZE "${bundle}/${name}" actual_bytes)
  if(NOT actual STREQUAL expected OR NOT actual STREQUAL selected OR NOT actual_bytes EQUAL expected_bytes)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Generated product differs: ${name}")
  endif()
endforeach()
add_library(dobot_selected INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(dobot_selected INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include"
  "${bundle}" "${UWVM_DOBOT_SOURCE_ROOT}/sdk/origin/include")
target_compile_definitions(dobot_selected INTERFACE "UWVM_DOBOT_PROFILE=${profile_number}")
if(UWVM_DOBOT_BUILD_CONTRACTS)
  add_executable(dobot_contract_c "tests/contract_${UWVM_DOBOT_PROFILE}.c")
  add_executable(dobot_contract_cpp "tests/contract_${UWVM_DOBOT_PROFILE}.cc")
  foreach(target IN ITEMS dobot_contract_c dobot_contract_cpp)
    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
    target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE dobot_selected)
  endforeach()
endif()
if(UWVM_DOBOT_BUILD_WASI_EXAMPLES)
  if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "WASI")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Actual WASI toolchain required")
  endif()
  add_executable(dobot_guest_c examples/guest.c)
  add_executable(dobot_guest_cpp examples/guest.cc)
  target_link_libraries(dobot_guest_c PRIVATE dobot_selected)
  target_link_libraries(dobot_guest_cpp PRIVATE dobot_selected)
endif()
foreach(target IN ITEMS dobot_contract_c dobot_contract_cpp dobot_guest_c dobot_guest_cpp)
  if(TARGET ${target})
    set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 CXX_STANDARD 20)
    if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "WASI")
      set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".wasm")
      target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-exceptions>")
      target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE "-Wl,--threads=1" "-Wl,-z,stack-size=1048576"
        "-Wl,--initial-memory=16777216" "-Wl,--max-memory=67108864")
    endif()
  endif()
endforeach()
